decode_layout: All fields little-endian; minimum 4 bytes, and 4+la bytes total (shorter input returns an empty Vec, no panic). off0: u8 p_sel -> p = PRIMES[p_sel % 6] with PRIMES=[2,3,5,7,11,13]; off1: u8 q_sel -> q = PRIMES[q_sel % 6]; n: u8 = p*q (4..=169, composite by construction). off2: u8 a_len_sel -> la = a_len_sel % 9 (0..=8); off3: u8 b_len_sel -> len_b = la + (b_len_sel % 9) + 1 (1..=17); off4..4+la: one u8 per element, a[i] = byte as usize % len_b; b = (0..len_b).collect(). Reconstructed args = advice_demo(n: u8, a: Vec<usize>, b: Vec<usize>). n is synthesised from two primes and b is a 0..len_b run because the program's jolt::check_advice*! assertions compile to RISC-V VirtualAssertEQ, whose failure aborts the emulator process rather than setting the guest panic flag; a prime n or a non-subset a would abort identically on BOTH arms and burn inputs. OUTPUT (LE): u8 a8, u8 b8, u16 a16, u16 b16, u32 a32, u32 b32, u64 a64, u64 b64, u64 idx_len then idx_len*u64 subset indices, u8 frob.x, u64 frob.y, u64 z_len then z_len*u16, 6*u32 triangle coords (p1.x,p1.y,p2.x,p2.y,p3.x,p3.y), u64 shoelace double.
entry_called: advice_demo(n: u8, a: Vec<usize>, b: Vec<usize>) — the lifted body of the original #[jolt::provable] fn, calling verify_composite_u8/u16/u32/u64, verify_subset, verify_frobnitz, verify_triangle_from_area (advice producers rewritten as the SDK's own compute_advice expansion minus the write_to_advice_tape call, since the template host supplies an empty untrusted-advice tape and no_std jolt-sdk has no AdviceTapeIO for Vec<T>; bytemuck Pod/Zeroable/JoltPod derives and impl AdviceTapeIO for Frobnitz dropped as unreachable tape plumbing — no dependency changes were needed)
